title: Old Man Mountain Manzanita Cradle-Only Now Available
content:
Now available on its own, Old Man Mountain‘s Manzanita Cradle ($150) gives riders the freedom to pair Old Man Mountain’s rigid handlebar cradle with the bag of their choice…

Old Man Mountain’s Manzanita Cradle was designed in partnership with Salsa Cycles. Previously available exclusively with two bag options optimized for drop-bar and flat-bar setups, the Manzanita Cradle is now available as a standalone cradle for riders with a favorite bag or who want to build a setup tailored to their needs.

The Manzanita is a bracket-mounted, rigid handlebar cradle built for all types of riding, from rugged shredpacking to champagne gravel. Its design provides ample mounting points for lights, computers, trackers, and other accessories, while offering a secure platform for carrying gear up front. With the new cradle-only option, riders can choose their own bag and build the Manzanita setup that works best for their bike, riding style, and next adventure.

Specs:

  • 6 accessory mounting points
  • 64 mm spaced mounts on the cradle arms
  • 70 mm spacing on the cradle
  • ¼ turn computer mount, action-cam mounts, and light mounts available
  • Rigid aluminum arms
  • Reinforced nylon cradle with easy mount bag hooks
  • Angle adjustable
  • 35mm and 31.8mm compatible
  • 363 grams
  • $150.00 (including cargo straps)

See more, including availability, dealers, and the whole line of cargo creations at Old Man Mountain.
